floorPlans.introduction: View the ground and first floors of the typical five-bedroom Bulgari Ocean Mansion.
floorPlans.note: Both drawings state 12,837.58 sq ft total built-up area. Figures below the selector are the printed areas of the individual floors. Confirm the layout and measurements for the particular mansion.

review: Matched both full typical floor drawings and their BUA panel to the branded brochure. The 6,568.63 and 6,268.95 sq ft figures sum to 12,837.58. The brochure map marks a possible eighth mansion while the developer’s current project page describes seven. Gallery and location copy avoid a count or current availability claim. Only the distinct Bulgari Ocean Mansions project’s own scenes and drawings are included.
unavailable: Mansion-specific plans and entrance coordinates were not publicly confirmed. The drawing and drive estimates come from the attributed brochure mirror.
